resolution.question: The Marlin Bay harbor advisory committee needs five of its nine members present to act. Will it reach quorum at its rescheduled Tuesday evening meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least five members (including the chair) are actually present at the meeting before the meeting ends or by 2026-08-11T21:00:00-07:00, whichever is earlier. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
